integrity: The all-dimensional claim is proved by a Monge assignment lower bound and a complete equality classification. Exact finite checks and independent LP optimizations corroborate but do not substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Square normalized nonsymmetric Monge polytopes with intrinsic Frobenius metric only; neither rectangular sizes nor alternative norms nor John ellipsoids are addressed. Available abstract but not full text of arxiv:2609.09508 inspected; possible undiscovered Euclidean coverage remains a residual risk.
title: An affine \(n-1\)-cube of Euclidean incenters for square Monge polytopes
